A tiny wooden fishing boat with two fishermen on a stormy night ocean, huge waves, lightning; suddenly an enormous glowing shadow sweeps over the water and the fishermen look up in shock.

Low angle from the sea: the colossal Hindu god Hanuman, muscular, golden crown and ornaments, saffron cloth, flies across the stormy night sky holding an entire glowing mountain on his raised palm, clouds parting around him, respectful and majestic.
Close-up of Hanuman's calm, determined face, golden crown, strong wind in the air, glowing green herbs shining on the mountain he carries, lightning reflecting in his eyes, divine and respectful.

Wide shot at dawn: the storm clears, colossal Hanuman lands softly on a cliff above a calm golden sea holding the glowing mountain, the two tiny fishermen in their boat below fold their hands in prayer.
